subject.title: feat(runner): support OpenClaw plugins across the ClawHub profile

question: Should ClawScan's public plugin target contract accept every native OpenClaw manifest that the host accepts, including JSON5 syntax?
rationale: The branch deliberately chooses strict JSON despite the host's documented JSON5 contract, so only the code owner can authorize that permanent compatibility split instead of repairing it.

options.title: Match OpenClaw JSON5
options.body: Use host-compatible JSON5 parsing and retain the existing security and identity checks.

options.title: Keep strict JSON
options.body: Explicitly sponsor and document a narrower ClawScan contract in which some host-valid plugins cannot be scanned as plugin targets.

recommendation.title: Match OpenClaw JSON5
recommendation.body: Use host-compatible JSON5 parsing and retain the existing security and identity checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the requested code owner and the strongest current-main history owner for the affected runner and scanner surfaces.
